description.text:
The Parlour is a stylish and innovative bar and restaurant, designed especially to accommodate groups of different sizes. From our decadent timber-panelled cocktail lounge to our intimate wine room, conservatory lounge and alfresco terrace complete with its own bar, giant umbrellas and fire pits, there's an area just right for your event, whether you're a small group or want to hire the whole venue for up to 650 guests.

Open for breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner and canape parties, The Parlour's imaginative food menu uses locally sourced ingredients at refreshingly good prices. At weekends, book a family party and keep your kids entertained with an array of fun-filled activities and games whilst enjoying a leisurely roast alongside a choice of Bloody Marys.

Book for corporate events, product launches, after-show and wrap parties, fashion shoots, music videos, TV commercials and celebrity interviews. Music and a late licence on Thursdays and Fridays make The Parlour the perfect place to start and end the party!

Location: The Park Pavilion Restaurants
